name: Transformers CYOA
source:
The Decepticons won the war, but hope is not lost. You and a couple of other newly born sparks are the Autobots' last chance to tip the balance and fight back. Will you rise to the challenge?

[From [url=https://useless19.itch.io/transformers-cyoa-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
